records.source_meaning: The resident says the book holds the secret of an ore nobody has seen before.
records.independent_English: It holds the secret of an ore no one's ever seen before.
records.context: The village resident remembers the monk who nursed people through an outbreak and treated the poison in their drinking water. The group recognizes his alchemy book, briefly drawing Charles into excited speculation. Rafael asks what became of the monk. The resident reveals that he fell ill himself, gave his medicine to the villagers and died. The group accepts the task of carrying on his search.
